title: POV: Day 9 of a 10-Day Sprint #shorts #devops
description:
Planned 38 points, the team does 21, and a scan drops 40 bugs mid-sprint. Plan with your real velocity, keep a 20% buffer, and put the Jira key in every branch and commit.

Full episode: "Agile, Scrum and Jira, Explained for DevOps | DevOps & SRE Zero to Hero Day 4" on the Tech-dev channel.
